title: Where Time Stood Still
build: Ocean's original 128K release (TOSEC: Where Time Stood Still (1988)(Ocean)(128K)[aka Land That Time Forgot, The][aka Tibet].tzx), a BASIC loader and SpeedLock 4 turbo blocks: the loading screen, 22,183 bytes of program, five 16 KB banks and 9,472 bytes of bank 7

tools.emulator: release ZEsarUX-13.0, ZEsarUX_linux-13.0-ubuntu24_x86_64.tar.gz, run as a Spectrum 128 (--machine 128k); check-emulator 42 of 45 on 17 October 2026 (count-while-running, load-keeps-frame-phase and warp, each with a workaround in kit/skills/spectrum/tool-zesarux)
tools.disassembler: SkoolKit 10.1 (control file, sna2skool), one control file a bank
tools.checker: codex-cli 0.163.0 (OpenAI Codex CLI), signed in with the contributor's ChatGPT subscription
tools.host: Linux x86_64 (Ubuntu 24.04, no display), a hosted cloud session

accuracy.note: 31 comments of main and 29 of bank 3, drawn before the four data banks were annotated; 17 of the checker's 18 marks held, and one comment it passed was wrong; all 18 corrected
main and bank 3 ported routine by routine and held to the game's code in lockstep; 11 comments corrected and 4 completed (port/corrections.md)
